from common import *

if __name__=='__main__':
    save_source(__file__)
    variant=sys.argv[1];assert variant in VARIANTS
    settings=read(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')['variants'][variant]
    treatments=['new']
    progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['status']='running';progress['scientific_candidates'][variant]['status']='running';write(PROGRESS,progress)
    for treatment in treatments:
        for seed in SEEDS:
            job=f'{variant}-{treatment}-s{seed}-a1'
            found=[j for j in read(PROGRESS)['jobs'] if j['job_id']==job]
            if found:
                assert len(found)==1 and found[0]['status']=='succeeded','inspect failed/incomplete job before resume'
                check(found[0]['evidence']);r=read(ROOT/found[0]['evidence']['path']);check(r['model']);continue
            harness('check')
            import statistics
            progress=read(PROGRESS)
            elapsed=[j['finished_at']-j['started_at'] for j in progress['jobs'] if j['status']=='succeeded']
            estimate=max(900.,1.25*statistics.median(elapsed)) if elapsed else 1200.
            remaining=read(STATE)['deadline']-time.time()
            reserve={'job_id':job,'at':time.time(),'remaining_seconds':remaining,'estimated_fit_seconds':estimate,'closeout_reserve_seconds':2700,'start_allowed':remaining>=estimate+2700}
            write(BASE/'docs'/f'reserve-{job}.json',reserve)
            if not reserve['start_allowed']:
                progress['status']='budget_stop_pending_closeout';write(PROGRESS,progress);raise SystemExit(75)
            with (TMP/f'{job}.log').open('w') as log:
                proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u',str(TMP/'train.py'),variant,treatment,str(seed)],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            if proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'{job} failed; inspect log and ledger')
            r=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{job}.json');print(job,'best',r['early_stopping'][0]['best_iteration'],'seconds',round(r['fit_seconds']),flush=True)
    progress=read(PROGRESS);progress['scientific_candidates'][variant]['status']='trained_awaiting_evaluation';write(PROGRESS,progress)
    print('group training complete',variant,flush=True)
